messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — bump window opens 09:00 PT tomorrow. Goal: sync API, runtime, console, SDK bumps in the same cut. API -> v1.12.0, runtime -> v0.44.0, console -> v3.5.2, sdks -> 2.1.0. Please add changelog bullets to each PR and flag any breaking tweaks (especially kv-cache/serialization).

alex: copying — I'll open the API PR tonight and tag @jen for the console client changes. PR will include a migration note for the header format.

jen: thanks. I can update console changelog + release notes. can someone confirm whether runtime's shader/quant kernels change needs a note?

raj: runtime bump will include the quant kernel swap. yes, add note: 'quant kernels change may alter perf on older GPUs; see runtime/README for fallback flags'. I'm running the integration tests now.

sam: quick ask — do we want to cut SDKs before or after canary? I'd prefer after canary if it's only docs/packaging.

maria: agree with sam. plan: merge API/runtime/console first, kick off canary, then cut SDKs once canary is green. We'll do a 2h canary window.

alex: API PR: https://github.com/redwoodinc/api/pull/529 — includes version bump, changelog, and compatibility tests. Needs one more review (cc @raj).

raj: looking now. small nit in the client header tests, fixed locally, pushing shortly. integration suite triggered: running.

ci-bot: integration-suite (runtime) — 3/124 flaky tests, 1 failing: tests/integration/kv_cache_test.py::test_eviction — collecting logs...

raj: kv_cache_test failure looks like a timing flake due to the new batching window. I'll add a short sleep in the test and open a follow-up PR to stabilize. Not a blocking change for bump, but will include note.

jen: console PR: https://github.com/redwoodinc/console/pull/2145 — changelog added, default feature flag unchanged. ready for merge after QA.

maria: checklist for tomorrow morning (paste into top of thread):
```
- Merge API/runtime/console PRs (must include changelog bullets)
- Start canary (09:30 PT) against staging cluster A
- Monitor token latency, error rate, and kv-cache regressions (15m checks)
- If canary green -> merge SDKS PRs and publish packages
- If canary fails -> rollback runtime PR and open incident thread
```

alex: noted. I'll be on watch for the first 30m of canary.

jen: QA can run smoke on console immediately after merges. ping me when API is merged so I can validate routing.

maria: tagging owners: @alex, @raj, @jen, @sam. If you won't be available during the window, reply here now. :clock1:

sam: I'm out 10:00-11:30 PT but will be reachable on slack for urgent things.

raj: tests passed locally after fix, pushing PR now.

ci-bot: deploy-checklist — canary cluster available: staging-a, canary-slot 3 reserved for 09:30 PT.

deploy-bot: Scheduled canary deploy at 2378502600 (09:30 PT). Will post status updates in this thread. :rocket:

maria: thanks all. final ask — please ensure changelog bullets are human-readable (one-liners). I'll assemble release notes after canary.

alex: will do. merging API after one more ack.

jen: on it.

(END)
